Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking our RFP. A few follow-ups from our Security & Procurement teams: can you provide detailed answers for the Support & TAM section (we're specifically looking for: TAM coverage hours, escalation tiers and contacts, on-call rotation model, incident communication timelines and templates, weekend/holiday coverage, and how you handle regional coverage in EU/CET hours)?

Also: please include any standard artifacts you can attach (support runbooks, template incident comms, TAM engagement SOW summary). We need this by EOD 2026-08-14 to keep to procurement timelines.

Specific asks: 
- Primary and secondary escalation contacts for P1/P2 incidents (name, role, phone, pager)
- Expected acknowledgement and update cadence for Severity 1/2/3
- Whether TAM is included in Dedicated contracts vs add-on (pricing/SLAs can be provided separately)
- Examples of previous incident comms (initial, status, RCA timeline)

Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps — procurement will likely want a short write-up we can attach to our SOW.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu

Acme Corp

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. High-level answers below and I’ve attached an overview and routing matrix to speed your review. Karthik (Support Engineering Lead) is looped in for the operational details.

High-level: 
- TAM coverage: TAMs operate Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 local business hours for the region on Dedicated contracts; standard TAM add-on extends to 24x5 coverage. For 24x7 critical coverage we provide a separate on-call SRE rotation for P1s.
- Escalation tiers: Tier 1 (Support L1) -> Tier 2 (Support Eng) -> Tier 3 (SRE/TAM) -> Executive on-call. Contact list and phone routing are in the attached CSV.
- Incident comms: We provide an initial acknowledgement within 15 minutes for P1s, hourly updates until mitigation, and a post-incident RCA within 72 hours for P1s. Templates attached.
- Regional coverage: We staff TAMs in US/EU/APAC. For EU customers we can align TAM hours to CET business hours; for Dedicated deployments you can request regionally based TAM assignment at contract time.

Attachments: Redwood-TAM-Coverage-Overview.pdf (3 pages), Support-Oncall-Routing.csv (routing matrix).

Let us know which items you want formalized into a statement of work or signed SLA and we'll prepare the doc for procurement. If useful, we can provide sample incident emails and a phone escalation confirmation.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah — following Neha's note, a more operational breakdown below (copied from our internal support matrix so you have concrete SLAs/routing).

Escalation / Coverage matrix (summary):
- Severity 1 (Platform down / production-blocking):
  - Acknowledge: 15 minutes (24x7 for Dedicated with 24x7 support add-on)
  - Initial mitigation update: 1 hour
  - Regular status updates: hourly until restored
  - RCA: preliminary within 24h, final within 72h
  - Contacts: Primary on-call SRE (pager), Secondary SRE, TAM for customer engagement. Phone and pager numbers in attachment.

- Severity 2 (Degraded service / partial outage):
  - Acknowledge: 1 business hour (for 24x5) or 30 minutes (for 24x7)
  - Updates: 4 hours cadence, RCA within 5 business days

- Severity 3 (Non-urgent):
  - Acknowledge: next-business-day
  - Updates: as mutually agreed

On-call & TAM model: 
- TAM: assigned for Dedicated customers by region; TAMs operate local business hours and own relationship, regular QBRs, health checks, runbook alignment.
- SRE on-call: 8-week rotation, primary pager during nights/weekends for P1s (covered by dedicated SRE team). If you contract 24x7 managed support, we provide follow-the-sun escalation across EU/US/APAC.

Incident communication channels:
- Primary: secure customer Slack channel / Microsoft Teams (preferred by account) for real-time updates.
- Secondary: Email distribution list + Pager/Phone for P1 escalation.
- Post-incident: RCA document + timeline + mitigation plan hosted on a shared Drive link.

Templates: attached Incident-Comms-Templates.docx (includes initial notification, hourly update, and final RCA template).

Exceptions & notes:
- Weekend/holiday coverage: included only with 24x7 managed support. Standard TAM add-on covers 24x5.
- Coverage guarantees: Specific regional TAM assignment and SLA targets are contract items for Dedicated deals; we can provide a signed addendum to the Master Services Agreement with those details.

Contact (ops escalation):
- Karthik Iyer, Support Engineering Lead — +1 (650) 555-0173 (pager available)
- Support: support@redwood.ai (ticket intake)

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Support Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Incident-Comms-Templates.docx (3 templates)]
